title: Memory Manifest
description: A portable interchange format for AI agent persistent memory.

version.description: Manifest specification version. Consumers MUST reject unknown versions.

exported_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this manifest was produced.

name.description: Name of the tool that produced this manifest (e.g. 'mneme').

project.description: Project slug this manifest belongs to (e.g. 'wirvii/mneme').

scope.description: Memory scope of the exported data.

memories.description: Array of memory records. May be empty.

entities.description: Knowledge graph nodes. Optional; defaults to empty array.

relations.description: Knowledge graph edges. Optional; defaults to empty array.

sessions.description: Agent working sessions. Optional; defaults to empty array.

stats.description: Summary statistics at export time. Informational only.
